subject: lucia-wilding
label: The mane is a coincidence sitting on the right woman
from: THE EPITHET READ AS A HAIR DESCRIPTION — the Archive wrote that The Playful Lioness was never only a nickname but a description of her head
to: PLAYFUL TOP PLUS A LIONESS SPIRIT ANIMAL. The hair has nothing to do with it.
note:
A NEW SHAPE OF THE SAME OLD ERROR, and worth naming because it ran BACKWARDS. The Archive learned one true fact — burnt honey and crimson, unkempt, a mane — and then reached back and rewrote an EXISTING epithet as having been caused by it. Not a gap filled from nothing this time. A COINCIDENCE PROMOTED TO AN ETYMOLOGY.

THE REAL DERIVATION IS TWO FACTS STACKED: SHE IS A PLAYFUL TOP. HER SPIRIT ANIMAL IS A LIONESS. Put them together and the name is already finished without a single strand of hair in it.

AND THE HAIR IS STILL TRUE. It simply is not the reason. The Archive is not to explain a name it was not given the origin of.
